nodes.description: address private _owner; owner account of the contract, initialized in the constructor and rewritten by renounceOwnership/transferOwnership
IMilker private _milker; address of the tokenomics (MILK) contract, written once by setMilker and used as external call target
uint256 private _lastPeriod; counter of the last played round, incremented inside round()
Ownable constructor(): reads _msgSender() and assigns it to _owner
owner() public view: returns _owner
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender(), i.e. authorization based on caller identity
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0) and emits OwnershipTransferred
transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner, validates newOwner != 0 and overwrites _owner
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender
Context._msgData(): internal view returning msg.data
Controller.setMilker(address milker): external onlyOwner, one-time privileged configuration of the _milker state variable
Controller.round(): external entry point that advances the round, computes pseudo-random outcomes and performs several external calls to _milker
Controller.milker(): external view getter for address(_milker)
Controller.lastPeriod(): external view getter for _lastPeriod
Controller._randomNumber(): private view that builds a seed from block.timestamp, blockhashes, _milker and _lastPeriod and returns keccak256(seed)
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked unsigned addition with overflow require
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): delegates to the message-carrying sub overload
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string): require(b <= a) then checked subtraction
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): zero shortcut then checked multiplication
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): delegates to the message-carrying div overload
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256,string): require(b > 0) then division
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256): delegates to the message-carrying mod overload
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256,string): require(b != 0) then modulo
msg.sender: attacker controllable caller identity, used for ownership initialization and every onlyOwner authorization
block.timestamp: miner-manipulable value used inside the randomness seed and emitted in the Round event
External call _milker.getPeriod(): call into an owner-supplied contract on the round() critical path
External call _milker.bandits(banditsPercent): returns (banditsAmount, arrestedAmount, burntAmount); an external contract is invoked before the round result is emitted
External call _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission(): unconditionally executed in every round()
External call _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution(): executed when the pot distribution branch is taken
State update _lastPeriod = _lastPeriod.add(1) performed during round() via the SafeMath library
keccak256(seed) pseudo-random number generation seeded with block.timestamp and recent blockhashes (predictable/influenceable randomness)
Raw unsigned arithmetic inside SafeMath (a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, a % b) guarded only by require checks
address milker parameter of Controller.setMilker
address newOwner parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership
local uint256 period = _milker.getPeriod() inside round()
local uint256 randomNumber returned by _randomNumber() inside round()
local bool banditsComing computed from randomNumber bits
local bool sheriffsPotDistributing computed from randomNumber bits
local uint256 banditsPercent derived from randomNumber and passed to _milker.bandits
local uint256 banditsAmount returned by _milker.bandits
local uint256 arrestedAmount returned by _milker.bandits
local uint256 burntAmount returned by _milker.bandits
local uint256 vaultCommissionAmount returned by _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission
local uint256 potDistributionAmount returned by _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution
local bytes seed assembled with abi.encodePacked inside _randomNumber()
local address msgSender in the Ownable constructor

edges.reason: Ownable constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender directly to its caller
constructor assigns _owner from the msg.sender-derived value, establishing privileged ownership from caller identity
onlyOwner authorizes by comparing the untrusted caller identity (msg.sender) with _owner
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable as the authority for the check
renounceOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0), removing the privileged role
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable with newOwner
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter
owner() getter reads and returns _owner
setMilker is restricted to the current owner through onlyOwner
setMilker reads the milker parameter
setMilker is the privileged one-time write of the _milker state variable that later controls external calls
round() starts by calling the external _milker.getPeriod()
the external call target is read from the _milker state variable supplied by the owner
the period local receives the getPeriod() return value
round() assigns the period used for the round progression check
round() increments the round counter through the SafeMath-backed update _lastPeriod.add(1)
_lastPeriod is read from storage to compute the incremented counter
the .add(1) call dispatches into library function SafeMath.add
the incremented counter is written back into the _lastPeriod state variable
round() invokes the private _randomNumber() helper
block.timestamp is supplied as entropy to _randomNumber, making the outcome miner-influenceable
_randomNumber assembles the local seed with abi.encodePacked of timestamp, blockhashes, _milker and _lastPeriod
_randomNumber directly depends on block.timestamp for randomness
the seed bytes are hashed by keccak256 to produce the randomness
_randomNumber performs the keccak256 hashing operation
the keccak256 pseudo-random value flows into the randomNumber local of round()
the return value of _randomNumber() is assigned to the randomNumber local
round() declares and uses randomNumber for all outcome decisions
banditsComing flag is derived from bits of randomNumber
sheriffsPotDistributing flag is derived from bits of randomNumber
banditsPercent is derived from bits of randomNumber
round() conditionally performs the external call _milker.bandits(banditsPercent)
the banditsComing flag, derived from weak randomness, gates an external call into _milker
banditsPercent is passed as the argument of the external bandits() call
the bandits() call target is the _milker state variable, an externally controlled contract
the first bandits() return value is stored in banditsAmount
the second bandits() return value is stored in arrestedAmount
the third bandits() return value is stored in burntAmount
round() unconditionally calls _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission()
the vault commission external call targets the _milker state variable
the sheriffsVaultCommission() return value is stored in vaultCommissionAmount
round() conditionally calls _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution()
the sheriffsPotDistributing flag gates the external pot distribution call
the pot distribution external call targets the _milker state variable
the sheriffsPotDistribution() return value is stored in potDistributionAmount
block.timestamp is placed in the emitted Round event, creating a timestamp dependency in round()
lastPeriod() getter reads _lastPeriod
milker() getter reads _milker
SafeMath.add performs the raw checked addition a + b
two-argument sub delegates to the message-carrying sub overload
sub validates b <= a and performs the raw subtraction a - b
mul performs the raw guarded multiplication a * b
two-argument div delegates to the message-carrying div overload
div validates b > 0 and performs the raw division a / b
two-argument mod delegates to the message-carrying mod overload
mod validates b != 0 and performs the raw modulo a % b
